description: Count how many acquirers on Ayebot's buyer register state an appetite for a sector in a Southeast Asian market. Use it for questions like "how many buyers are there for a healthcare business in Malaysia?" or "how many private equity buyers look at logistics in Singapore?". Give sector and market for one cell; sector only for that sector across all six markets; market only for every sector in that market; neither for register totals. Accepts keys (e.g. "fnb", "sg") or plain names (e.g. "food and beverage", "Singapore"). Returns aggregate counts split into strategic, private equity, family office and other. Never returns names. Call list_sectors_and_markets for valid values.

market.description: Market key or name: sg, my, id, th, vn, ph (Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, Philippines). Omit for all markets.

sector.description: Sector key or name, e.g. "healthcare", "F&B", "logistics". Omit for all sectors.

name: count_buyers
title: Count acquirers by sector and market
